full_prompt_en: A square, painterly monochrome portrait presents a dark-haired young woman seated at a table in a dim interior, enclosed by an irregular pale border. The background is deep brown-black with only a few soft rectangular forms suggesting shelves or wall recesses behind her. She sits a little left of center, wearing a dark garment with a wide neckline and loose sleeves. Her wavy hair is gathered around her head, with stray curls softening the outline against the shadow. Her face tilts downward and slightly toward the right; one hand rises to the side of her cheek, while the other arm rests across the table in the lower half of the image. The expression is quiet and inward, with lowered eyes and a relaxed mouth. A crumpled pale cloth lies in front of her, its folds catching the brightest light and drawing a gentle horizontal line across the foreground. The table surface remains dark and indistinct, allowing the illuminated hands and fabric to carry the nearest detail. Broken, rubbed edges around the image resemble an aged photographic print or rough painted mount, introducing patches of cream and warm brown into the mostly black, gray, and sepia range. Soft light enters from the upper left, shaping the forehead, cheek, forearm, and cloth before falling rapidly into the surrounding darkness. Grain, slight blur, and uneven tonal transitions give the image a tactile, old-print quality rather than a polished digital finish. The overall composition is intimate and still, with pale skin and fabric suspended within generous dark space.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、带绘画感的近单色肖像呈现一名深发年轻女子坐在昏暗室内的桌边，画面被不规则浅色边框围住。背景是深棕黑色，只有几个柔和的矩形形状暗示她身后的架子或墙面凹处。她坐在中央偏左，身穿领口宽阔、袖子宽松的深色衣物。波浪发围拢在头部，零散卷发让她与阴影之间的轮廓更柔和。她的脸向下并微微朝右，一只手抬到脸颊侧面，另一只手臂横放在画面下半部的桌面上。低垂的目光和放松的嘴唇让神情显得安静而内省。她面前有一块揉皱的浅色布，褶皱承接最明亮的光，在前景形成温和的横向线条。桌面保持深暗而模糊，使受光的手与织物承载最近处的细节。画面四周破碎、摩擦般的边缘像老照片或粗糙画框，在以黑、灰和棕褐色为主的色域中加入奶油色与暖棕色斑块。柔光从左上方进入，塑造额头、脸颊、前臂和布料，然后迅速沉入周围的暗部。颗粒、轻微模糊及不均匀的明暗过渡赋予图像可触的旧印相质感，而不是光滑的数字完成面。整体构图亲密而静止，浅色皮肤与布料仿佛悬于宽阔的黑暗空间中。
style_prompt_en: A painterly photographic treatment compresses color toward warm sepia, charcoal, cream, and soft gray while preserving subtle brown undertones. Large dark areas frame a restrained pool of light, so a few pale planes and creased surfaces become the focal points. Edges alternate between gentle blur and rough, abraded interruptions; fine grain and rubbed patches give the surface an aged-print feel. Light falls obliquely from above, shaping forms through gradual midtones before they disappear into dense shadow. The composition stays close and quiet, relying on broad tonal masses and sparse illuminated detail for its emotional weight.
style_prompt_zh: 带绘画感的摄影处理把颜色压向暖棕褐、炭黑、奶油色和柔灰，同时保留细微的棕色底调。大片暗部围住一小片克制的亮区，使少量浅色平面与褶皱表面成为焦点。边缘在轻柔模糊与粗糙磨损的断裂之间交替；细颗粒和擦痕赋予表面老印相的感觉。光从上方斜落，以渐进的中间调塑造形体，再让它们隐入浓密阴影。构图保持近距离而安静，依靠宽阔的明暗色团和稀疏受光细节承载情绪。
theme_en: A contemplative dark-haired woman seated beside a tabletop
theme_zh: 一位深发女子坐在桌边沉思
name: Casey Baugh
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
